description: Search publicly listed post-production facilities, distribution vendors and creative companies. Filter by free text, by place slug (from list_places) and by service uuid (from list_services). To find vendors somewhere, prefer `place`; a `query` naming a place is treated as one anyway, and the response reports it as `resolvedPlace`. Results are paginated; when `hasMore` is true, call again with the returned `nextOffset`.

locale.description: Two-letter language code (en, fr, es, pt, it, de, nl, pl, th, hi, ko, ja). Defaults to English.

query.description: Free text matched against facility and company names, or a place name

name: search_facilities
title: Search the vendor directory
